episodes.name: S.A.T. Blues
episodes.overview: Dana is beside herself when Cody outscores her on the SATs; the kids help themselves to Frank's clothes.

episodes.name: To B or Not to Be
episodes.overview: Frank teaching Shakespeare? 'Twould indeed be nobler to suffer the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune.

episodes.name: Stuck on You
episodes.overview: To outdo the "superdad" of Al's friend, Frank enters a Human Fly contest in which he has to bounce off a trampoline and stick to a wall.

episodes.name: JT's World
episodes.overview: J.T. and Cody team for "J.T.'s World" on TV, but when a guest bats her eyes at Cody, J.T. gives him the boot.

episodes.name: It's a Dog's Life
episodes.overview: The family dog-sits a Saint Bernard that keeps Frank away from Carol, and terrorizes Mark.

episodes.name: The Boss
episodes.overview: As assistant manager of the 50's Cafe, Dana runs the ship like Capt. Queeg--and drives the help to mutiny.

episodes.name: Model Daughter
episodes.overview: Karen's modeling job rouses the mother hen in Carol; the flu hits at home, testing the nurse in Frank.

episodes.name: Someone to Watch  Over Me
episodes.overview: Frank goes out on a limb--a tree limb--to keep an eye on Dana and her date, a teenage make-out artist known as Mike the Mover.

episodes.name: The Making of the President
episodes.overview: It's J.T. vs. Dana for student-body president, pitting schmo against smarty--and Frank against Carol.

episodes.name: Virgin Territory
episodes.overview: J.T. is mystified: Cody's still a virgin; and he plans to stay that way for the "dudette of his dreams."

episodes.name: Back to Basics
episodes.overview: Brendan feels responsible for a crackdown on family spending after he loses a rented video.

episodes.name: Boys Will Be Boys
episodes.overview: A visit by Frank's boorish bud sends Carol into orbit; Cody becomes attached to a live holiday turkey he won in a raffle.

episodes.name: If I Were a Rich Man
episodes.overview: Cody's not sure how to spend the fortune left to him by a friend at a rest home, but it's not for a lack of suggestions.

episodes.name: Happy Birthday, Baby
episodes.overview: Dana's plans for her birthday party don't include Carol, but Frank's plans definitely do.

episodes.name: One of the Guys
episodes.overview: Carol may be a '90s woman, but she can't see Frank's gorgeous co-worker as one of the guys. Meanwhile, the kids gamble their savings on the commodities market.

episodes.name: No Business Like Show Business
episodes.overview: J.T. sees himself a star when a producer likes his TV show; in art class, Carol sees a lot that Frank doesn't like.

episodes.name: Love, Port Washington Style
episodes.overview: Dana's been dumped, Frank burns one of Carol's customers, and J.T.'s limo date backfires.

episodes.name: Aloha (1)
episodes.overview: Adventure and romance abound on a family trip to Maui, where Dana's swept off her feet by a far-from-typical beach bum.

episodes.name: Aloha (2)
episodes.overview: Amid Maui's adventures, will...Dana marry Brian? Carol relax? J.T. and Cody find treasure? Brendan, Mark and Al win a helicopter tour?

episodes.name: No Way to Treat a Lady
episodes.overview: J.T.'s woman is a biker who wants to be treated like a lady. Meanwhile, Al yearns for her first bra.

episodes.name: The Un-Natural
episodes.overview: Carol goes to bat for Mark when he wants on the Cubs just before their big game.

episodes.name: The Psychic
episodes.overview: A psychic predicts J.T. will be killed by a woman in red whose name starts with K. Meanwhile, Frank and Carol contend with a mechanical bed with a mind of its own.

episodes.name: This Old House
episodes.overview: Frank's hired to raze a house for a new building, but a family's still living there--with nowhere to go.

episodes.name: Double Date
episodes.overview: Carol sticks Karen with a date who doesn't rate--so Karen dumps him.
